title: Pure Cyber Girl
summary: Pure Cyber Girl Fusion strategy representing Alexis Rhodes' athletic dancer archetype from Yu-Gi-Oh! GX, led by Etoile Cyber, Blade Skater, and their Fusion boss Cyber Blader. Using Fusion Deployment, Fusion Conscription, and Cyber Tutubon, the deck consistently fields its classic Warrior materials to summon Cyber Blader and unleash its scaling board-locking effects.

summary.title: Starters
points: Fusion Deployment reveals Cyber Blader from the Extra Deck to Special Summon either Etoile Cyber or Blade Skater directly from your Deck.
Fusion Conscription reveals Cyber Blader to search the missing named Fusion Material (Etoile Cyber or Blade Skater) from your Deck or GY to hand.
Reinforcement of the Army searches any of your Level 4 or lower Warriors, including Etoile Cyber, Blade Skater, or Cyber Gymnast.
Cyber Egg Angel searches Ritual Sanctuary or adds Alexis-themed consistency Spells to grease the engine.

summary.title: Opening: Fusion Deployment + Polymerization
steps: Activate Fusion Deployment, revealing Cyber Blader from the Extra Deck to Special Summon Blade Skater directly from your Deck.
Normal Summon Etoile Cyber (or search it via Fusion Conscription / Reinforcement of the Army).
Activate Polymerization to fuse Etoile Cyber and Blade Skater into Cyber Blader.
Position Cyber Blader to maximize its continuous effects based on the opponent's monster count.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Cyber Blader is the centerpiece Fusion boss whose continuous effect scales dramatically with the opponent's monster count: with exactly 1 opponent monster, it cannot be destroyed by battle; with 2, its ATK doubles to 4200; with 3, it negates all activated effects of opponent's Spells, Traps, and Effect Monsters.
Cyber Prima is a Level 6 LIGHT Warrior that destroys all face-up Spell Cards on the field when Tribute Summoned, blowing out continuous backrow and field spells.
Cyber Gymnast discards 1 card once per turn to target and destroy any face-up Attack Position monster the opponent controls.
Cyber Tutu can attack the opponent directly if every monster they control has higher ATK than Cyber Tutu's 1000 ATK.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Polymerization is the core Fusion Spell, easily searched and repeatedly utilized to field Cyber Blader.
Cyber Tutubon Special Summons itself by tributing a Warrior or Fairy from hand or field, and recycles Ritual or Fusion Spells when tributed.

allow.Fusion Deployment: Reveals Cyber Blader in the Extra Deck to Special Summon Etoile Cyber or Blade Skater directly from the Deck.
allow.Fusion Conscription: Reveals Cyber Blader in the Extra Deck to add Etoile Cyber or Blade Skater from Deck or GY to the hand.
allow.Polymerization: Essential Fusion Spell searchable via Cyber Egg Angel and recycled via Cyber Tutubon to summon Cyber Blader.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Etoile Cyber, Blade Skater, Cyber Tutu, or Cyber Gymnast.
